about: Modwerk source-only improved-amp package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/improved-amp.

mods.title: Improved AMP
mods.summary: The AMP page reworked: HLD from no hold to AUTO, shown in steps; ATK, DEC and REL in fine steps from 0.2 ms, shown as times; a finer OVR; and ENV RESET AMP without a click.
mods.description: Always on while installed. AMP HLD runs from no hold (0) to AUTO (127), never cuts the attack and reads in steps at the current tempo and track speed. AMP and FILTER ATK, DEC and REL move in 0.2 ms steps up to 5 ms and read as times. AMP OVR keeps its 0 to 127 number and is finer at its low end. SOUND SETTINGS > ENV RESET gains AMP and AMP+FILT: a sequenced trig or retrig of such a sound is faded out just before it, so the envelope restarts from silence without a click. Saved sounds play their HLD, ATK, DEC, REL and OVR values on the new curves while it is installed. It carries Env Reset Amp's ENV RESET values and cannot be installed with it.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: On an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as reported by the author's automated USB test rig on 11 November 2026: this package's source on a development build of the Modwerk base with a USB test link, loaded to RAM (IL04), passed 25 cases covering the AMP and FILTER screens, HLD in steps, lengths by DEC and HLD, OVR's curve, the FILTER times, and ENV RESET AMP's fade across sequenced trigs, retrigs, swing, micro timing, sound locks, mutes and trig conditions. This package linked alone (IA12) ran from RAM with MIDI notes and CCs only and read hold, decay, attack and OVR alike. Not run: pads, a power cycle, a boot from flash. This package's own bytes have not been flashed from the site.
